prerequisites: Students should be know digital processing and electrical engineering.

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire essential knowledge of data transmission through transmission lines and associated linear distortion effects.
Acquire the main principles in pulse modulation, source coding, channel coding, data modems and data transmission services.
Acquire theoretical and practical knowledge and skills of data transmission through metallic transmission lines, data coding and pulse modulation.

syllabus_topics: Analog and digital communication systems, units
Signal classification, characteristics of signals mean value, energy, power
The relationship between time domain and frequency domain
Quantization and sampling of signal + PCM

assessment_methods.method: Attendance at seminars, laboratory and PC exercises

assessment_rules: Attendance at seminars, laboratory and PC exercises is required. Students solve two tests during the semester. The course is finished by an oral exam, where the student must respond to questions from a predefined set of topics. The form of course completion is an examination.
